issues.title: Proposal: separate responsibilities in plugin setup (src/index.ts)
Testing-3: triage the 231 tests that pin nothing — strengthen or delete
readLines can return a partial trailing record during concurrent append
Secrets already in the store are never scrubbed, and memory_export writes them verbatim
P1: unresolved named sessions publish private memories into the last repo or globally
memory_export has no repo-visibility filter — any session can export every repository's rows
